# Greater Texas Behavioral

> Licensed virtual outpatient mental health treatment program (Virtual OP), delivered entirely through secure telehealth to adults anywhere in Texas. Care combines individual therapy and therapist-led groups while clients live at home and keep up with work, school and family.

Service area: all of Texas, 100% online (no physical treatment location). Admissions (24/7): (877) 590-3665. Email: info@greatertexasbehavioral.com. Part of Quadrant Health Group (https://quadranthealthgroup.com).

Key facts:
- Program: Virtual Outpatient Program (OP), with multiple therapy sessions per week by secure, HIPAA-compliant video: individual therapy, therapist-led group sessions, cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), coping and emotional-regulation skills, personalized treatment plans and family support sessions.
- Mental health conditions treated: anxiety disorders, depression, PTSD and trauma-related symptoms, bipolar disorder, mood instability and stress-related challenges.
- Scope: Greater Texas Behavioral is a mental health treatment program only. It does not operate a standalone substance use disorder treatment program and does not provide detox. When a client receiving mental health care also has co-occurring substance use, it is addressed within their mental health treatment plan.
- Insurance: works with most major PPO plans, including UnitedHealthcare, Aetna, Humana, Blue Cross Blue Shield, Cigna, Ambetter, TRICARE and VA / Veterans Affairs. Insurance verification is free and confidential.
- Getting started: initial consultation, insurance verification, a virtual clinical assessment, then structured telehealth sessions.

## Overview

- [Virtual Mental Health Treatment in Texas](https://www.greatertexasbehavioral.com/): Greater Texas Behavioral offers a fully licensed virtual outpatient mental health treatment program, delivered through secure telehealth anywhere in Texas.
- [Blog](https://www.greatertexasbehavioral.com/blog/): Insights on mental health and virtual treatment from the team at Greater Texas Behavioral.

## Treatment

- [What We Treat](https://www.greatertexasbehavioral.com/what-we-treat/): The Texas Virtual OP treats mental health conditions (anxiety, depression, trauma, PTSD and mood disorders) through secure, evidence-based telehealth.
- [Anxiety, Depression & Stress](https://www.greatertexasbehavioral.com/what-we-treat/#mental-health): Online treatment for generalized anxiety, panic, social anxiety, depression and stress-related challenges.
- [Trauma & PTSD](https://www.greatertexasbehavioral.com/what-we-treat/#trauma): Trauma-informed online care for PTSD, trauma-related symptoms, emotional regulation, and grief and loss.
- [Mood Disorders](https://www.greatertexasbehavioral.com/what-we-treat/#mood): Online treatment for bipolar disorder and mood instability, with long-term wellness planning.

## Admissions & Insurance

- [Verify Your Insurance](https://www.greatertexasbehavioral.com/verify-insurance/): Verify your insurance for Virtual OP treatment in Texas. Greater Texas Behavioral works with most major PPO providers, and verification is quick, confidential and free.
- [Contact Us](https://www.greatertexasbehavioral.com/contact/): Speak with an admissions specialist about the virtual outpatient mental health program, anywhere in Texas. The admissions line is open 24/7.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.greatertexasbehavioral.com/faq/): How telehealth treatment works, what insurance covers, what a week looks like and how to get started.
